name_zh: 桑托斯/石油/内战结束：石油后冲突治理与多元化转型
name_en: Santos/Oil/Post-Civil War: Post-Oil Conflict Governance & Diversification Transition
description_zh: 若泽·爱德华多·多斯·桑托斯 (1942-2022) 安哥拉总统 (1979-2017) 38 年，1975 独立后即陷入内战(UNITA/南非/古巴/苏联/美国卷入)/2002 萨文比阵亡内战结束/石油主导经济(出口 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 交权若昂·洛伦索/反腐/多元化/改革。体现 M168 石油后冲突治理——以"内战结束+石油收益管理+反腐改革+多元化转型"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型。
description_en: Jose Eduardo dos Santos (1942-2022) Angola President (1979-2017) 38 years, 1975 independence immediate civil war (UNITA/South Africa/Cuba/USSR/US involved)/2002 Savimbi death war ends/oil dominates economy (exports 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 handover to Joao Lourenco/anti-corruption/diversification/reforms. Exemplifies M168 Post-Oil Conflict Governance—quaternity of 'war ends + oil revenue management + anti-corruption reforms + diversification transition' driving post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy.
reason_zh: 安哥拉非单纯石油国家，而是"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体后冲突转型试验。多斯·桑托斯以石油收益维持政权/重建基建/军队，洛伦索以反腐/多元化/改革打破石油依赖。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"内战结束即转型窗口+石油收益即转型资本+反腐即制度前提+多元化即战略目标"的非洲石油国家转型范式。
reason_en: Angola not mere oil state but 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' quaternity post-conflict transition experiment. Dos Santos used oil revenue to maintain regime/rebuild infra/military, Lourenco drives anti-corruption/diversification/reforms breaking oil dependency. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'war end as transition window + oil revenue as transition capital + anti-corruption as institutional prerequisite + diversification as strategic goal' African oil state transition paradigm.
steps_zh: 内战结束开启转型窗口：2002 萨文比阵亡/卢安达备忘录/UNITA 非武装化/难民回流/国家统一，和平即发展前提
石油收益管理与主权财富基金：索纳格尔国有/国际油企分成/收入透明化(EITI)/主权财富基金(FSF)/基建/教育/医疗投入
反腐改革与制度重构：洛伦索 2017 上台/多斯·桑托斯家族/将军/索纳格尔高管调查/司法独立/公共采购透明/资产申报
多元化转型战略：农业/渔业/矿业/旅游/制造/物流/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/可再生能源/数字经济，摆脱单一石油
区域融合与外交平衡：南共体/大湖区/葡语共同体/中美俄/欧盟/非盟/洛比托大西洋枢纽，区域稳定器
steps_en: War end opens transition window: 2002 Savimbi death/Luena MOU/UNITA demobilization/refugee return/national unity, peace as development prerequisite
Oil revenue management & SWF: Sonangol state-owned/IOC revenue sharing/transparency (EITI)/Sovereign Wealth Fund (FSF)/infra/education/health investment

Anti-corruption reforms & institutional reconstruction: Lourenco 2017 takes office/dos Santos family/generals/Sonangol executives investigated/judicial independence/public procurement transparency/asset declaration
Diversification transition strategy: agriculture/fisheries/mining/tourism/manufacturing/logistics/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/renewables/digital economy, escaping single-oil dependency
Regional integration & diplomatic balance: SADC/Great Lakes/CPLP/China-US-Russia/EU/AU/Lobito Atlantic hub, regional stabilizer
expected_zh: 以"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型，为非洲石油国家提供冲突后转型范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' drives post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy, providing post-conflict transition paradigm for African oil states.
case_zh: 1975 独立/1975-2002 内战/2002 和平/2017 洛伦索上台/反腐/多元化/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/石油依赖 90%+→70% 目标，石油国家转型艰难前行。
case_en: 1975 independence/1975-2002 civil war/2002 peace/2017 Lourenco takes office/anti-corruption/diversification/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/oil dependency 90%+->70% target, oil state transition difficult journey.
